3. Your responsibilities

Use the application and website lawfully. Only access accounts, local folders, and cloud files you own or are authorized to use. Respect the rights of other people and the rules of your organization and service providers.

Do not use the website to attempt unauthorized access, distribute malware, disrupt the service, or misrepresent your identity. Responsible vulnerability reporting is welcome through the security reporting process.

You remain responsible for your files, account permissions, configuration, backups, and decisions about any operation. A selection preview is not a backup or proof that a transfer occurred. Review release notes and visible warnings before relying on a build.

4. Google Drive authorization

Google authorization is optional and occurs in your system browser. Google controls sign-in, consent, account availability, and the Google Drive service under its own terms and policies. LedgeSync cannot guarantee continued API access or permission for every account.

LedgeSync requests per-file drive.file access, not unrestricted access to all Drive files. Connecting does not start a sync job. You may disconnect locally or revoke authorization through your Google Account. Remote revocation can affect the account’s authorizations for other clients in the same Google Cloud project; review any confirmation carefully.

Our Privacy Policy explains the account information and credentials processed by the app, local storage, website data, and available controls.

5. Developer-alpha limitations and availability

Available features depend on the installed version. Alpha.3 provides local browsing, policy explanations, simulated previews and Google authorization. Starting with alpha.4, desktop and native CLI builds also support approved folder copies into a selected Google Drive destination, with verification and explicit retry after interruption. Active ignore rules apply. Starting with alpha.5, optional automatic copies run only for sync pairs you explicitly authorize, while the desktop app or a CLI command you start is running, and you can restore a copy into a new local folder. Shared-drive support, overwriting and deletion are not enabled. The website describes current downloads; unreleased source changes may not be present in installed versions.

Developer builds may contain defects or incomplete features. Some installers lack publisher signing or notarization; follow platform security guidance and the installation documentation. There is no promise of uninterrupted availability, a support response time, compatibility with every system, or delivery of planned features. Do not rely on this alpha as your only protection against data loss.

The maintainers may update the website, documentation, or available releases and may restrict abusive website access. Removing a hosted download does not revoke rights already granted under its open-source license.
